paite: TOUPA aw, bang achia gamlapi a dingh nak na hia? Bang achia mangbat lai bang a kisel nak?
heading: Thudik A Vaihawm Ngetna
english: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

paite: Migilou-salou kisaktheihna ziak in migentheite delh in a-om uhi, athil gilou ngaihtuahkhiakte uah amau mah awk uhen.
english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

paite: Migilou-salou in alungtang ut lam asuang, mihuaiham in TOUPA apaikhia a, amusit hi.
english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.

paite: Migilou-salou in kisaktheih melpu in, angaihtuahna ah, Pathian a-om kei, achi hi. Angaihtuahna tengteng tuh, Pathian a-om kei, chih ngen ahi.
english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

paite: A-omdante tuh chik lai peuh in leng akip a; na vaihawmnate tunglam gamlapi ah, amuh bat louh ah, a-om hi; Amah doute tengteng lah anuihsan maimah ngal a.
english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

paite: Alungsim in, "Ka ling kei ding, khang tengteng tan in mangbang in ka om kei ding," achi hi.
english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

paite: Akam hamse lohnate, khemnate, mengbawlnate in adim a; alei nuai ah thilhihkhelhna leh siatna a-om hi.
english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

paite: Kho teng a guktanna munte ah atu zel a; mundai ah khelhna nei lou mite athat zel hi, amit in tasam mite aguktan nak ahi.
english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

paite: Humpinelkai in akua a aguktan bang in ama'n mundai ah aguktan zel hi; mitasam man ding in atang zel a, mitasam aman ngei a, huchi in alen in akaimang nak hi.
english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

paite: Abokkhup a, akun a, bangmah hihthei lou amihatte uh hihpuk in a-om nak uhi.
english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

paite: Alungsim ah, Pathian in amangngilh ahi; amai asel a, chik mah chiang in amu kei ding, achi hi.
english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

paite: TOUPA aw, thou in; Pathian aw, na khut lik in, migentheite mangngilh ke'n;
english: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

paite: Bangziak in ahia migilou-salou in Pathian amuhsit, alungsim a, na phut kei ding, achih nak?
english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

paite: Muh zaw na mu khin tham a; na khut a thuk ding thil hihkhial leh hihvuina na en a, migentheite na kiang ah akikemsak ua; pa nei lou panpihpa na hi.
english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

paite: Migilou-salou ban sutan inla, migilou, gitlouhna zongkhia in, na muh het louh mateng.
english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

paite: TOUPA tangtawn tangtawn a ding in Kumpipa ahi a; namte amah gam a pan in amangthang uhi.
english: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

paite: TOUPA, kingainiamte deihna na ngaikhia a; alungtang uh na kisasak ding a, abil un leng na zasak ding hi.
english: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

paite: Pa neiloute leh nuaisiah a omte, leitung mi'n a-engbawl nawnlouhna ding un, avai uh hawmsak in.
english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
